verdict.rationale: Fireworks markets 'Run the latest open models with a single line of code' and 'instant access to the most popular OSS models' across a 100+ model catalog. Its Hugging Face custom-model upload gives a self-serve route to deploy a new open-weight model without waiting for the official catalog. The evidence never quantifies how quickly newly released models arrive, so the story's speed claim rests on marketing language plus a do-it-yourself workaround. Missing for 10: documented day-0 or time-to-availability commitments, concrete examples of fast launches of newly released models, independent or hands-on corroboration of release speed.
